source: AI Video Bootcamp's 'Consistent Character Voices' lesson - the sixteen named vocal-delivery templates it lists (each written around an [accent] slot) for keeping a character's spoken voice/dialogue delivery identical across separate video generations. The course's own core rule: define the voice once with specific traits, then copy the exact same description into every prompt for that character - even a small wording change shifts the tone the model produces.
note: A voice blueprint is not one of realism_lint.py's 8 gated photorealism layers and is not folded into Compose's Subject field the way a persona's visual traits are - it is a standalone, copyable block of text meant to be pasted into whatever prompt or dialogue text actually needs the character to speak (this app has no per-line dialogue field of its own). `styles` are templates with one `{accent}` slot each, filled by compose_voice(); `custom` typed text always wins entirely, same precedence as every other builder in this project.

conversational.label: Conversational
conversational.phrase_template: speaks with a subtle {accent}, natural mid-tempo pacing, friendly and relaxed tone. briefly pauses before key words as if thinking. sentences taper off slightly rather than ending sharply.
conversational.when: An easygoing, natural-sounding narrator or presenter voice - the safe default.

confident.label: Confident
confident.phrase_template: light {accent}, steady deliberate delivery, calm authority in the voice. controlled pacing with clear pauses between statements. never rushed, every phrase lands with intention.
confident.when: A presenter who needs to sound sure of themselves without being aggressive.

energetic.label: Energetic
energetic.phrase_template: subtle {accent}, fast lively rhythm, enthusiasm rises when emphasizing a point. delivery feels animated and expressive, like someone excitedly sharing a story.
energetic.when: Hype UGC, unboxings, anything that needs to feel excited rather than calm.

casual.label: Casual
casual.phrase_template: light {accent}, loose conversational pace. sounds like talking with a close friend. occasionally breaks sentences, uses natural filler sounds like 'um' or 'like'. tone is relaxed and informal.
casual.when: Everyday UGC and vlog-style talking that shouldn't sound scripted.

storytelling.label: Storytelling
storytelling.phrase_template: light {accent}, expressive storytelling cadence. pacing varies naturally - slower during description, faster during exciting moments. voice carries curiosity and subtle emotional shifts.
storytelling.when: A narrator walking through a story or a sequence of scenes.

calm-thoughtful.label: Calm / Thoughtful
calm-thoughtful.phrase_template: subtle {accent}, slower reflective pace. soft tone with gentle pauses between ideas. sounds like someone carefully choosing their words while explaining something meaningful.
calm-thoughtful.when: Reflective narration, wellness content, anything that shouldn't feel rushed.

persuasive.label: Persuasive
persuasive.phrase_template: light {accent}, confident persuasive rhythm. slightly emphasises important words, small pauses before key statements. tone feels convincing and composed.
persuasive.when: Sales-adjacent copy or a call to action that needs to land without shouting.

professional.label: Professional
professional.phrase_template: subtle {accent}, clean controlled delivery, medium pace. clear pronunciation with slight pauses between sentences. tone feels polished and articulate.

dramatic.label: Dramatic
dramatic.phrase_template: light {accent}, deliberate cinematic pacing. longer pauses for tension, emphasis on emotional words. voice carries weight and seriousness.
dramatic.when: Trailer-style narration or a scene that needs real weight behind it.

curious-analytical.label: Curious / Analytical
curious-analytical.phrase_template: subtle {accent}, thoughtful pace with slight hesitation before ideas. tone sounds inquisitive, as if exploring the topic while speaking.
curious-analytical.when: A reviewer or explainer thinking out loud rather than reciting a script.

friendly-warm.label: Friendly / Warm
friendly-warm.phrase_template: light {accent}, gentle rhythm, soft welcoming tone. speech flows smoothly with small pauses that feel natural and reassuring.
friendly-warm.when: A welcoming host voice - onboarding, tutorials, anything that should feel kind.

sarcastic-playful.label: Sarcastic / Playful
sarcastic-playful.phrase_template: subtle {accent}, relaxed tempo with slight vocal smirks in the delivery. emphasis shifts unpredictably to highlight humor or irony.
sarcastic-playful.when: Comedic or deadpan content that leans on tone as much as the words.

authority-leader.label: Authority / Leader
authority-leader.phrase_template: light {accent}, controlled confident cadence. speaks slowly enough to command attention. strong emphasis on decisive words.
authority-leader.when: A leader/expert figure whose voice needs to carry weight in the room.

reflective-emotional.label: Reflective / Emotional
reflective-emotional.phrase_template: subtle {accent}, slower pacing with pauses that feel introspective. voice softens during emotional phrases, almost like thinking out loud.
reflective-emotional.when: A personal, emotional beat - a confession, a memory, a quiet moment.

conversational-story-mode.label: Conversational Story Mode
conversational-story-mode.phrase_template: light {accent}, casual narrative rhythm. sounds like someone explaining an experience to a friend. sentences occasionally restart mid thought.
conversational-story-mode.when: A 'storytime' style clip told like an unscripted personal anecdote.

fast-social-media-style.label: Fast Social Media Style
fast-social-media-style.phrase_template: subtle {accent}, quick modern pacing, energetic delivery. short bursts of speech with strong emphasis on key words.
fast-social-media-style.when: Short-form hooks and fast-cut social content where every second counts.
